concerns.text: Using LocalDateTime.now() directly in TaskService.updateTaskStatus makes the code less testable; injecting a Clock or time supplier is preferred.

The test testReconciliationEmitsTelemetryWhenPrClosedAndNotMerged relies on a cast to ch.qos.logback.classic.Logger and uses logback-specific ListAppender. This tightly couples the test to the Logback implementation, which will break if the logging framework is changed or shaded in the future.

Using string-containment checks on the formatted log message for telemetry verification could be fragile if log formats change. Standardizing telemetry using a dedicated event publisher or JSON-structured logs would be more robust.
